requirement: The checker must reject empty requirement text and definitions that are not the sole definition at the start of a paragraph.
justification: Scenarios: an empty definition, prefixed prose, heading placement, multiple definitions in one paragraph, and invalid IDs. Paragraph lookup and prefix/used-range checks reject ambiguity before evidence can be matched; tests exercise every listed invalid placement. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
